findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Claims.Rules.|CatastropheEvent|_| matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: category/prefix check on "CAT-" (line 15): no accepted record names "CAT-". A category exemption lets one category bypass the rule; an exemption needs its own decision record, whatever the code comments call it. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.

Rule-bearing legacy code in Claims.Rules.referToSiu matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: case keyed on CatastropheEvent (line 20): no accepted record names CatastropheEvent. A category test treats one category differently (a possible exemption); a record that names the category must authorize it. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.

Rule-bearing legacy code in Claims.Rules.acknowledgeWithin matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). Superseded authority: numeric literal 36 (line 26): value 36 = DEC-CL06.p1 (superseded by DEC-CL09, value only) and no accepted parameter. The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for Customer Care: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
